issue.title: UModal is not restoring focus to the trigger after closing
issue.body:
### Environment

- @acme/ui: 1.4.0
- Vue: 3.5.13

### Description

When a `UModal` closes, focus is dropped on the body instead of returning to the button that opened it. Keyboard users lose their place in the page and have to tab from the top again.

### Expected behavior

Focus should return to the trigger, as the dialog pattern requires.
issue.author: rwhitfield

similar.title: Modal does not return focus to the trigger on close
similar.body: Closing a UModal leaves focus on the document body rather than on the element that opened it, so keyboard navigation restarts from the top of the page.

similar.title: Modal backdrop click closes the dialog while a select is open
similar.body: Clicking the backdrop while a USelect inside the modal is open closes the whole modal instead of just the select.

similar.title: Tooltip stays visible after the trigger unmounts
similar.body: A UTooltip left open when its trigger is removed from the DOM never disappears.
